about.description: VuMe Bond 2030 is a Luxembourg securitisation note (ISIN CH1509100140) issued by Realiz Digital Assets Fund and tokenized on Stellar via the Bitbond platform. Underlying borrower is TPT Global Tech Inc. (OTC: TPTW), with proceeds funding the VuMe Live AI Super App. Notes are represented as SEP-41 tokens on Stellar. Tokenization type is Represented (not freely transferable). $500M total issuance, 0.75% management fee. Non-U.S. Accredited Investors only, $100,000 minimum.
about.registryInfo: Realiz Digital Assets Fund (Luxembourg). LEI 984500C40D99BE804B62. Regulatory framework: Luxembourg Securitisation Law (22 Mar 2004, amended 8 Mar 2022) - CSSF supervised. Crypto custodian: Tangany; Auditor: Ernst & Young; Paying agent: Bank Frick; Traditional broker: SIX Network. ISIN CH1509100140.
